title: FTC Takes Action Against Fake Amazon Guru Kevin David for Automation @Coffeezilla
summary: Amazon seller reacts to an FTC action against an Amazon-automation guru: done-for-you packages rarely pay back, selling on Amazon is hard and not passive.

assertions.quote: when you invest 30 000 and you don't get 30 000 back that's a problem

verdicts.note: FTC actions and refund orders against automation sellers document widespread losses.

FTC alleges Empire/Automators sold automated-store packages at $10,000-$125,000 plus $15,000-$80,000 working capital, virtually no purchasers earned the advertised income, most lost their entire investment and nearly all stores were suspended; DK Automation's packages (up to $100,000) likewise left few consumers making money.
